verse.verse_2: By the Book that makes things clear;-
verse.verse_3: We sent it down during a Blessed Night: for We (ever) wish to warn (against Evil).
verse.verse_4: In the (Night) is made distinct every affair of wisdom,
verse.verse_5: By command, from Our Presence. For We (ever) send (revelations),
verse.verse_6: As Mercy from thy Lord: for He hears and knows (all things);
verse.verse_7: The Lord of the heavens and the earth and all between them, if ye (but) have an assured faith.
verse.verse_8: There is no god but He: It is He Who gives life and gives death,- The Lord and Cherisher to you and your earliest ancestors.
verse.verse_9: Yet they play about in doubt.
verse.verse_10: Then watch thou for the Day that the sky will bring forth a kind of smoke (or mist) plainly visible,
verse.verse_11: Enveloping the people: this will be a Penalty Grievous.
verse.verse_12: (They will say:) "Our Lord! remove the Penalty from us, for we do really believe!"
verse.verse_13: How shall the message be (effectual) for them, seeing that an Messenger explaining things clearly has (already) come to them,-
verse.verse_14: Yet they turn away from him and say: "Tutored (by others), a man possessed!"
verse.verse_15: We shall indeed remove the Penalty for a while, (but) truly ye will revert (to your ways).
verse.verse_16: One day We shall seize you with a mighty onslaught: We will indeed (then) exact Retribution!
verse.verse_17: We did, before them, try the people of Pharaoh: there came to them a messenger most honourable,
verse.verse_18: Saying: "Restore to me the Servants of Allah: I am to you an messenger worthy of all trust;
verse.verse_19: "And be not arrogant as against Allah: for I come to you with authority manifest.
verse.verse_20: "For me, I have sought safety with my Lord and your Lord, against your injuring me.
verse.verse_21: "If ye believe me not, at least keep yourselves away from me."
verse.verse_22: (But they were aggressive:) then he cried to his Lord: "These are indeed a people given to sin."
verse.verse_23: (The reply came:) "March forth with My Servants by night: for ye are sure to be pursued.
verse.verse_24: "And leave the sea as a furrow (divided): for they are a host (destined) to be drowned."
verse.verse_25: How many were the gardens and springs they left behind,
verse.verse_27: And wealth (and conveniences of life), wherein they had taken such delight!
verse.verse_28: Thus (was their end)! And We made other people inherit (those things)!
verse.verse_29: And neither heaven nor earth shed a tear over them: nor were they given a respite (again).
verse.verse_30: We did deliver aforetime the Children of Israel from humiliating Punishment,
verse.verse_31: Inflicted by Pharaoh, for he was arrogant (even) among inordinate transgressors.
verse.verse_32: And We chose them aforetime above the nations, knowingly,
verse.verse_33: And granted them Signs in which there was a manifest trial
verse.verse_34: As to these (Quraish), they say forsooth:
verse.verse_35: "There is nothing beyond our first death, and we shall not be raised again.
verse.verse_36: "Then bring (back) our forefathers, if what ye say is true!"
verse.verse_37: What! Are they better than the people of Tubba and those who were before them? We destroyed them because they were guilty of sin.
verse.verse_38: We created not the heavens, the earth, and all between them, merely in (idle) sport:
verse.verse_39: We created them not except for just ends: but most of them do not understand.
verse.verse_40: Verily the Day of sorting out is the time appointed for all of them,-
verse.verse_41: The Day when no protector can avail his client in aught, and no help can they receive,
verse.verse_42: Except such as receive Allah's Mercy: for He is Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
verse.verse_44: Will be the food of the Sinful,-
verse.verse_45: Like molten brass; it will boil in their insides.
verse.verse_46: Like the boiling of scalding water.
verse.verse_47: (A voice will cry: "Seize ye him and drag him into the midst of the Blazing Fire!
verse.verse_48: "Then pour over his head the Penalty of Boiling Water,
verse.verse_49: "Taste thou (this)! Truly wast thou mighty, full of honour!
verse.verse_50: "Truly this is what ye used to doubt!"
verse.verse_51: As to the Righteous (they will be) in a position of Security,
verse.verse_53: Dressed in fine silk and in rich brocade, they will face each other;
verse.verse_54: So; and We shall join them to fair women with beautiful, big, and lustrous eyes.
verse.verse_55: There can they call for every kind of fruit in peace and security;
verse.verse_56: Nor will they there taste Death, except the first death; and He will preserve them from the Penalty of the Blazing Fire,-
verse.verse_57: As a Bounty from thy Lord! that will be the supreme achievement!
verse.verse_58: Verily, We have made this (Qur'an) easy, in thy tongue, in order that they may give heed.
verse.verse_59: So wait thou and watch; for they (too) are waiting.
